do_dont.do: Show scale (drop, stretch on bed, king coverage)
do_dont.dont: Claim heat / lavender / weighted unless CloudFur SKU has it

do_dont.do: Name the color like a character
do_dont.dont: Copy Comfrt/Mellow brand names or OST text verbatim

do_dont.do: Soft CTA: “grab your color” / “size that fits”
do_dont.dont: Fake “4 hours left” unless real offer

recipes.title: A. Collection / abundance (from Comfrt #1/#4)
recipes.hook: Camera on a pile of CloudFur throws (or one hero + folded stack). Start counting or “I may have a problem…”
recipes.body: “This is the [Color] — same cloud fur as the rest.”
recipes.close: “Pick the color you’d actually leave out on the couch.”

recipes.title: B. New-color unbox (from #2 / Mellow #10)
recipes.hook: Box or folded drop-in: “CloudFur just hit [ColorName].”
recipes.body: Drape on bed; one size line (“covers the whole couch”).

recipes.title: C. 7s texture ASMR (from #5)
recipes.hook: Trend audio + CloudFur already on couch.
recipes.close: Freeze on product — no VO needed.

recipes.title: D. Size ladder (from #7/#12)
recipes.hook: On-screen “CloudFur size check” (or OST equivalent you own).
recipes.hold: Drop or hold each size in order.
recipes.body: One line per size (lap / couch / bed) — only if sizes are real.

recipes.title: E. Sensory bed VO (from Mellow #8 — closest cousin)
recipes.hook: In bed under CloudFur: “You’re not getting up after this.”
recipes.hold: Word hits on screen: cloud · fluffy · soft (your words, not theirs).
recipes.body: Hands + cheek on fur; show drape width.
recipes.close: Soft ask — “your color’s in the cart.”

checklist: At least one **scale proof** (drop or full-bed).
CTA = shop color/size — not fake urgency.
Skip heated/lavender/weighted scripts unless the SKU matches.

patterns: Auto open AND auto close is the #1 demo beat (button press on camera).
100 mph / windproof claim is the highest-scoring hook pattern (scores 8–9).
Comparison frames win: basic vs Repel, Chinese vs Japanese, kids-hate-cheap.
Car-entry / purse-backpack compact storage is the top lifestyle pain.
ES creators convert (gift for sister, 'se abre sola') — keep bilingual briefs.
Extreme-weather proof (nor'easter) had best ROI ($7.36) despite low views.

prompts.tiktok: Film a 20–35s vertical Repel umbrella demo. Hook in first 2s with a wind or auto-close claim ("takes 100 mph wind" OR "opens AND closes with one button"). Show: (1) one-button open, (2) one-button close, (3) fold into purse/backpack or car door entry without getting wet, (4) 9-rib / double-vented canopy close-up. Optional: hold a cheap flimsy umbrella next to it for 3s. End with color options + orange cart CTA. Talk natural, no price war. Lifetime warranty line optional.
prompts.ai_video: Vertical 9:16 UGC-style product video, 25 seconds. Woman 25–40 outdoors on a windy overcast day holds a black compact travel umbrella with red inner canopy. Beat 1 (0–3s): look to camera — "this umbrella takes 100 mph wind." Beat 2: press button, canopy snaps open, wind gusts but canopy holds, vented double layer visible. Beat 3: press button, auto-closes, slides into tote/backpack. Beat 4: quick cut comparing a bent cheap metal umbrella vs this 9-rib fiberglass frame. Natural handheld selfie angle, soft daylight, no text overlays, no logos beyond product, end on product in hand with subtle smile. Photoreal, TikTok native.
